C10_00_door.speaker: narrator
C10_00_door.text: A door of warm gold light. Beyond it, the First Crossing, where the very first Promise was made.

C10_01_bridge.speaker: narrator
C10_01_bridge.text: The First Crossing. A bridge of lanterns over nothing at all, between two worlds. Long ago, a human and a spirit met in the middle and promised to keep the way open.

C10_01_bridge.speaker: narrator
C10_01_bridge.text: Most of the lanterns are dark. At the far end, a wall of silence blocks the bridge.

C10_01_bridge.speaker: lumi
C10_01_bridge.text: He's putting them out, one by one.

C10_01_bridge.speaker: elias
C10_01_bridge.text: Four lanterns left on the posts. They're old Promise lanterns. They light for anyone who remembers why they keep the Promise.

C10_01_bridge.speaker: narrator
C10_01_bridge.text: New goal: relight the four lanterns. Each of your friends has a reason.

lantern_lit.speaker: narrator
lantern_lit.text: The lantern burns warm and steady.

C10_01_lantern_1.speaker: elias
C10_01_lantern_1.text: This one's mine. ...I was a radio that nobody listened to any more. Then a whole town remembered its name because I kept broadcasting. I keep the Promise because somebody should always be listening.

C10_01_lantern_1.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_1.text: Elias crackles with static. The lantern lights.

C10_01_lantern_1.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_1.text: All four lanterns burn. At the end of the bridge, the wall of silence cracks and falls away.

C10_01_lantern_2.speaker: maris
C10_01_lantern_2.text: I was stuck in dead vines, forgetting I could grow. You pulled me out. I keep the Promise because things grow back, if you let them.

C10_01_lantern_2.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_2.text: A green shoot curls around the post. The lantern lights.

C10_01_lantern_2.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_2.text: All four lanterns burn. At the end of the bridge, the wall of silence cracks and falls away.

C10_01_lantern_3.speaker: taro
C10_01_lantern_3.text: I tell lies for a living. Here's a true thing: I was lonely in that carnival, every single night. I keep the Promise because it's better with an audience. Ahem. With friends.

C10_01_lantern_3.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_3.text: Taro snaps his fingers. A real flame this time, not an illusion. The lantern lights.

C10_01_lantern_3.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_3.text: All four lanterns burn. At the end of the bridge, the wall of silence cracks and falls away.

C10_01_lantern_4.speaker: galen
C10_01_lantern_4.text: I kept a gate for longer than your town has had a name. I kept the Promise because I was told to. Now I keep it because I choose to.

C10_01_lantern_4.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_4.text: Galen breathes on the lantern, slow and patient. It lights.

C10_01_lantern_4.speaker: narrator
C10_01_lantern_4.text: All four lanterns burn. At the end of the bridge, the wall of silence cracks and falls away.

fc01_shards_beaten.speaker: narrator
fc01_shards_beaten.text: The shards fall into the void without a sound.

C10_02_heart.speaker: narrator
C10_02_heart.text: The Heart of the Crossing. A round floor of old gold, and in the middle, the Keeper, holding the last lantern in both hands, ready to put it out.

C10_02_keeper_intro.speaker: keeper
C10_02_keeper_intro.text: You came. Of course you came. You're her token and her light. I should have known.

C10_02_keeper_intro.speaker: reno
C10_02_keeper_intro.text: We came to bring you home.

C10_02_keeper_intro.speaker: keeper
C10_02_keeper_intro.text: There is no home when the doors are open. Only people falling through them.

C10_02_keeper_intro.speaker: lumi
C10_02_keeper_intro.text: Then we'll catch them. That's what the Promise is FOR.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: narrator
C10_02_silence_rises.text: The Keeper falls to his knees. The last lantern rolls out of his hands, still burning.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: keeper
C10_02_silence_rises.text: I can't... I'm so tired. Twelve years of keeping everything quiet.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: narrator
C10_02_silence_rises.text: But the silence he made doesn't stop when he does. It pours out of his grey coat, out of every erased page, every forgotten name, and stands up behind him, enormous.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: keeper
C10_02_silence_rises.text: No. No, no. I didn't mean... It's all of it. All the forgetting. It's going to swallow both worlds.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: narrator
C10_02_silence_rises.text: Reno's railway token glows in his hand. Lumi glows back. Somewhere, very faintly, two voices they have never heard but somehow know say: Together.

C10_02_silence_rises.speaker: narrator
C10_02_silence_rises.text: Reno and Lumi learned the team skill Promise Renewed! (Both heroes' turns, four timed presses.)

C10_03_silence_intro.speaker: narrator
C10_03_silence_intro.text: The Great Silence turns its faceless head. Every lantern on the bridge flickers.

C10_03_silence_intro.speaker: reno
C10_03_silence_intro.text: Hey, Silence! You're really, REALLY quiet! I'm gonna be really, really LOUD!

C10_03_promise.speaker: narrator
C10_03_promise.text: Promise Renewed. Reno's token and Lumi's light, and behind them every lantern on the bridge, all at once. The Great Silence breaks like a held breath let go, and the sound of two worlds comes rushing back.

C10_03_promise.speaker: narrator
C10_03_promise.text: When the light settles, there are two more figures on the bridge. A railway worker with a lantern. A guardian made of soft light. Echoes, only echoes, but smiling.

C10_03_promise.speaker: maya_echo
C10_03_promise.text: Look at you. You kept the token.

C10_03_promise.speaker: seri_echo
C10_03_promise.text: And you kept each other. That's the whole Promise, really.

C10_03_promise.speaker: reno
C10_03_promise.text: Are you... are you coming back?

C10_03_promise.speaker: maya_echo
C10_03_promise.text: We're keeping the door on our side. Someone has to. Visit us, every Lantern Moon.

C10_03_promise.speaker: narrator
C10_03_promise.text: Seri's echo touches Lumi's forehead. Then they're gone, and the bridge is warm.

C10_03_promise.speaker: keeper
C10_03_promise.text: ...I heard her. Twelve years ago. I heard her and I made myself forget.

C10_03_promise.speaker: lumi
C10_03_promise.text: You can remember now. That's allowed.

C10_03_promise.speaker: galen
C10_03_promise.text: The Oathkeepers were never meant to force anything. Will you help us keep it the right way? Anyone who wants to cross may cross. Anyone who wants to stay may stay.

C10_03_promise.speaker: keeper
C10_03_promise.text: A Promise you choose. Not one that chooses for you. ...Yes. If you'll have me.

C10_03_promise.speaker: narrator
C10_03_promise.text: Everyone puts a hand on the last lantern: a radio, a flower, a juggler, a boulder, a tired man in a grey coat, and two kids from two worlds.
